# Rajvardhan Singh Badgujar — Cloud & DevOps Engineer

> Portfolio, cloud architecture projects, automation workflows, and technical expertise of Rajvardhan Singh Badgujar, Cloud & DevOps Engineer based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India.

Rajvardhan specializes in architecting zero-downtime infrastructure, automated CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) across AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform.

## Core Capabilities
- **Cloud Architecture**: AWS (EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, Lambda, CloudFront), Microsoft Azure.
- **Containers & Orchestration**: Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes (EKS/AKS), Helm.
- **Infrastructure as Code**: Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible.
- **CI/CD & GitOps**: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD.
- **Monitoring & Observability**: Prometheus, Grafana, Linux system administration.
- **Full-Stack Development**: Python (FastAPI), Nginx, WebSockets, HTML5, Tailwind CSS.

## Key Projects
- [DevOps Accelerator](https://rajvardhansingh.in/projects/devops-accelerator): Production CI/CD pipeline simulation with automated GitHub Actions workflows and Dockerized EC2 deployments.
- [EC2 + S3 Static Hosting](https://rajvardhansingh.in/projects/aws-ec2-s3-static-hosting): High-availability hybrid cloud static hosting with Nginx reverse proxy and CloudFront CDN.
- [Personal Private Cloud](https://rajvardhansingh.in/projects/personal-private-cloud): Hardened self-hosted Nextcloud infrastructure with Docker Compose, Redis caching, and PostgreSQL.
- [Infrastructure as Code Pipeline](https://rajvardhansingh.in/projects/iac-cicd-pipeline): Automated multi-tier AWS VPC provisioning with CloudFormation, automated security audits, and GitOps delivery.
- [SecureExam Platform](https://rajvardhansingh.in/projects/secureexam-platform): Anti-cheating proctoring web application with AI face verification, WebSocket alerts, and FastAPI.
- [Thikana Dhabla Ghosi](https://rajvardhansingh.in/projects/thikana-dhabla-ghosi): Cultural heritage platform with interactive family genealogy trees and Google Maps integration.
